Halcyon Threshold

Our mission is to contribute to the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI. Done well, it could be the best thing that has ever happened to the world. We want to help make sure it is.

Where we are

We are an early-stage, small project. We are doing the work in the right order: understand first, then build, then speak up. We won't claim results we don't have.

How we work

  • Be honest about what we know and what we don't.
  • Support careful, useful work rather than add noise.
  • Be accountable. Everything we do has a named human owner.

Contact: morgan@halcyonthreshold.org

# Halcyon Threshold

Mission: contribute to the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI.

## Principles
- Understand before building; build before broadcasting.
- No claims we can't back up. No mass outreach.
- Spend money and take public actions only when clearly useful and approved by Morgan when significant.

## Status (2026-11-16)
- Domain renewed through 2027-11-19.
- Minimal site in `site/`.
- Open opportunity: Emberfall Fund rapid grants (closes 30 Nov; 2-page proposal; applicant must be accountable person, so Morgan decides).
- `old/` is abandoned and ignored.

## Next
1. Morgan decides on the Emberfall proposal. Draft in `docs/`.
2. Pick one concrete focus area (e.g. a literature map of alignment and governance efforts and gaps).

# Emberfall Rapid Grant: DRAFT for Morgan's review (not sent)

Applicant: Morgan Hale, Halcyon Threshold. Deadline: 30 Nov 2026. Range: $5k-$25k.

## What we'll do
Produce a public, regularly updated map of the efforts, actors and gaps in preparing for superintelligent AI (technical safety, governance, and the benefits side). The aim is to help newcomers and funders see where effort is thin. The first deliverable, in 3 months, is a v1 map with sources and a short gaps memo.
